**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

§ 22 already delivers every preferred element of the AUDIT rule:

- **Frequency** — "no more than once in any twelve-month period" (§ 22.1)
- **Notice** — "at least thirty days' prior written notice" (§ 22.1)
- **Conduct** — "during normal business hours"; "off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality" (§ 22.1)
- **Cost** — Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2)
- **No system access** — "Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly" (§ 22.2)

§ 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no operative parallel audit obligation, and no remote-access, telemetry-based verification or unannounced inspection right binding us appears elsewhere in the agreement. § 22.3 (audit findings as our Confidential Information, shortfall payment resolving the issue) is additionally favourable to us. No redline proposed.
